verses.heading: 燔祭的条例

verses.text: “<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>晓<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>谕<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yù</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>色<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sè</rt></ruby><ruby>列<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>间<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiān</rt></ruby><ruby>若<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ruò</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>献<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>供<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>物<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wù</rt></ruby><ruby>给<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡěi</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby>，<ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>牛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">niú</rt></ruby><ruby>群<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qún</rt></ruby><ruby>羊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>群<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qún</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>献<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>牲<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>畜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chù</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>供<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>物<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wù</rt></ruby>。

“<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>供<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>物<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wù</rt></ruby><ruby>若<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ruò</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>牛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">niú</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>燔<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fán</rt></ruby><ruby>祭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>会<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huì</rt></ruby><ruby>幕<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mù</rt></ruby><ruby>门<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mén</rt></ruby><ruby>口<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>献<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>只<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>没<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">méi</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>残<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cán</rt></ruby><ruby>疾<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jí</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>公<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>牛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">niú</rt></ruby>，<ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>面<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miàn</rt></ruby><ruby>前<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qián</rt></ruby><ruby>蒙<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ménɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>悦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuè</rt></ruby><ruby>纳<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>按<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">àn</rt></ruby><ruby>手<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>燔<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fán</rt></ruby><ruby>祭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jì</rt></ruby><ruby>牲<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>头<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tóu</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>燔<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fán</rt></ruby><ruby>祭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jì</rt></ruby><ruby>便<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biàn</rt></ruby><ruby>蒙<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ménɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>悦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuè</rt></ruby><ruby>纳<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby>，<ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>赎<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shú</rt></ruby><ruby>罪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuì</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>面<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miàn</rt></ruby><ruby>前<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qián</rt></ruby><ruby>宰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>公<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>牛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">niú</rt></ruby>；<mark class="pn"><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yà</rt></ruby><ruby>伦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lún</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>孙<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sūn</rt></ruby><ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>祭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jì</rt></ruby><ruby>司<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sī</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>奉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>血<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xuè</rt></ruby>，<ruby>把<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>血<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xuè</rt></ruby><ruby>洒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>会<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huì</rt></ruby><ruby>幕<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mù</rt></ruby><ruby>门<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mén</rt></ruby><ruby>口<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kǒu</rt></ruby>、<ruby>坛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tán</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>周<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōu</rt></ruby><ruby>围<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nà</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>剥<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bō</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby><ruby>燔<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fán</rt></ruby><ruby>祭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jì</rt></ruby><ruby>牲<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>皮<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pí</rt></ruby>，<ruby>把<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>燔<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fán</rt></ruby><ruby>祭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jì</rt></ruby><ruby>牲<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>切<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiē</rt></ruby><ruby>成<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>块<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kuài</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>祭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jì</rt></ruby><ruby>司<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sī</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yà</rt></ruby><ruby>伦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lún</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>孙<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sūn</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>把<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>火<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>放<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>坛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tán</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>把<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>柴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chái</rt></ruby><ruby>摆<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>火<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby>。

<mark class="pn"><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yà</rt></ruby><ruby>伦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lún</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>孙<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sūn</rt></ruby><ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>祭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jì</rt></ruby><ruby>司<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sī</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>把<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>肉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ròu</rt></ruby><ruby>块<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kuài</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>头<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tóu</rt></ruby><ruby>并<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>脂<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>油<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yóu</rt></ruby><ruby>摆<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>坛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tán</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>火<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>柴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chái</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>但<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Dàn</rt></ruby><ruby>燔<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fán</rt></ruby><ruby>祭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jì</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>脏<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>腑<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>与<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>腿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tuǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>用<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>水<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>洗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xǐ</rt></ruby>。<ruby>祭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jì</rt></ruby><ruby>司<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sī</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>把<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>切<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiè</rt></ruby><ruby>全<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">quán</rt></ruby><ruby>烧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shāo</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>坛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tán</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>当<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>燔<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fán</rt></ruby><ruby>祭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>献<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>与<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>馨<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby><ruby>香<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>火<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>祭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jì</rt></ruby>。

“<ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Rén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>供<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>物<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wù</rt></ruby><ruby>若<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ruò</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>绵<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mián</rt></ruby><ruby>羊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>或<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huò</rt></ruby><ruby>山<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shān</rt></ruby><ruby>羊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>燔<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fán</rt></ruby><ruby>祭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>献<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>没<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">méi</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>残<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cán</rt></ruby><ruby>疾<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jí</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>公<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>羊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yánɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yào</rt></ruby><ruby>把<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>羊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>宰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>于<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yú</rt></ruby><ruby>坛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tán</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>北<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">běi</rt></ruby><ruby>边<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biɑn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>面<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miàn</rt></ruby><ruby>前<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qián</rt></ruby>；<mark class="pn"><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yà</rt></ruby><ruby>伦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lún</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>孙<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sūn</rt></ruby><ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>祭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jì</rt></ruby><ruby>司<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sī</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>把<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>羊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>血<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xuè</rt></ruby><ruby>洒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>坛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tán</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>周<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōu</rt></ruby><ruby>围<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby>。

verses.text: “<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>晓<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>谕<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yù</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>色<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sè</rt></ruby><ruby>列<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>，<ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>切<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiè</rt></ruby><ruby>走<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>兽<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shòu</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>吃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chī</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>乃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>些<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiē</rt></ruby>：

<ruby>凡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fán</rt></ruby><ruby>蹄<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tí</rt></ruby><ruby>分<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fēn</rt></ruby><ruby>两<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>瓣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bàn</rt></ruby>、<ruby>倒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>嚼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiáo</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>走<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>兽<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shòu</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>吃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chī</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>但<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Dàn</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>倒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>嚼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiáo</rt></ruby><ruby>或<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huò</rt></ruby><ruby>分<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fēn</rt></ruby><ruby>蹄<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tí</rt></ruby><ruby>之<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>吃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chī</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>乃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby>：<ruby>骆<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">luò</rt></ruby><ruby>驼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tuo</rt></ruby>，<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>倒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>嚼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiáo</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>分<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fēn</rt></ruby><ruby>蹄<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tí</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>与<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>洁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jié</rt></ruby><ruby>净<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìnɡ</rt></ruby>；

<ruby>沙<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shā</rt></ruby><ruby>番<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fān</rt></ruby>，<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>倒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>嚼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiáo</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>分<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fēn</rt></ruby><ruby>蹄<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tí</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>与<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>洁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jié</rt></ruby><ruby>净<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìnɡ</rt></ruby>；

<ruby>兔<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tù</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby>，<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>倒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>嚼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiáo</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>分<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fēn</rt></ruby><ruby>蹄<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tí</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>与<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>洁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jié</rt></ruby><ruby>净<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìnɡ</rt></ruby>；

<ruby>猪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhū</rt></ruby>，<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>蹄<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tí</rt></ruby><ruby>分<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fēn</rt></ruby><ruby>两<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>瓣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bàn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>却<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">què</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>倒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>嚼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiáo</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>与<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>洁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jié</rt></ruby><ruby>净<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìnɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>些<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiē</rt></ruby><ruby>兽<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shòu</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>肉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ròu</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>吃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chī</rt></ruby>；<ruby>死<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>摸<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mō</rt></ruby>，<ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>与<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>洁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jié</rt></ruby><ruby>净<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìnɡ</rt></ruby>。

“<ruby>水<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shuǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>吃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chī</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>乃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>些<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiē</rt></ruby>：<ruby>凡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fán</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>水<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby>、<ruby>海<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby>、<ruby>河<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby>、<ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>翅<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chì</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>鳞<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lín</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>吃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chī</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>凡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Fán</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>海<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby>、<ruby>河<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>并<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>切<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiè</rt></ruby><ruby>水<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>游<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yóu</rt></ruby><ruby>动<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>活<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huó</rt></ruby><ruby>物<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wù</rt></ruby>，<ruby>无<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wú</rt></ruby><ruby>翅<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chì</rt></ruby><ruby>无<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wú</rt></ruby><ruby>鳞<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lín</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>当<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>憎<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zēnɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>些<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiē</rt></ruby><ruby>无<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wú</rt></ruby><ruby>翅<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chì</rt></ruby><ruby>无<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wú</rt></ruby><ruby>鳞<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lín</rt></ruby>、<ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>憎<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>吃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chī</rt></ruby><ruby>它<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>肉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ròu</rt></ruby>；<ruby>死<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>当<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>憎<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zēnɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>凡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Fán</rt></ruby><ruby>水<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>无<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wú</rt></ruby><ruby>翅<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chì</rt></ruby><ruby>无<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wú</rt></ruby><ruby>鳞<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lín</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>当<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>憎<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zēnɡ</rt></ruby>。

“<ruby>雀<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Què</rt></ruby><ruby>鸟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">niǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>当<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>憎<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zēnɡ</rt></ruby>、<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>吃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chī</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>乃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby>：<ruby>雕<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">diāo</rt></ruby>、<ruby>狗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>头<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tóu</rt></ruby><ruby>雕<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">diāo</rt></ruby>、<ruby>红<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>头<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tóu</rt></ruby><ruby>雕<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">diāo</rt></ruby>、

<ruby>鹞<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>鹰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīnɡ</rt></ruby>、<ruby>小<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>鹰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>与<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>其<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qí</rt></ruby><ruby>类<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lèi</rt></ruby>；

<ruby>乌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wū</rt></ruby><ruby>鸦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yā</rt></ruby><ruby>与<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>其<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qí</rt></ruby><ruby>类<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lèi</rt></ruby>；

<ruby>鸵<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tuó</rt></ruby><ruby>鸟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">niǎo</rt></ruby>、<ruby>夜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yè</rt></ruby><ruby>鹰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīnɡ</rt></ruby>、<ruby>鱼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yú</rt></ruby><ruby>鹰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīnɡ</rt></ruby>、<ruby>鹰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>与<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>其<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qí</rt></ruby><ruby>类<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lèi</rt></ruby>；

<ruby>鸮<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiāo</rt></ruby><ruby>鸟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">niǎo</rt></ruby>、<ruby>鸬<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lú</rt></ruby><ruby>鹚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cí</rt></ruby>、<ruby>猫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">māo</rt></ruby><ruby>头<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tóu</rt></ruby><ruby>鹰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīnɡ</rt></ruby>、

<ruby>角<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>鸱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chī</rt></ruby>、<ruby>鹈<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tí</rt></ruby><ruby>鹕<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hú</rt></ruby>、<ruby>秃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tū</rt></ruby><ruby>雕<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">diāo</rt></ruby>、

<ruby>鹳<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuàn</rt></ruby>、<ruby>鹭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lù</rt></ruby><ruby>鸶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sī</rt></ruby><ruby>与<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>其<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qí</rt></ruby><ruby>类<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lèi</rt></ruby>；<ruby>戴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dài</rt></ruby><ruby>鵀<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>与<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>蝙<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biān</rt></ruby><ruby>蝠<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fú</rt></ruby>。

verses.text: <ruby>除<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Chú</rt></ruby><ruby>非<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fēi</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>骨<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>肉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ròu</rt></ruby><ruby>之<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>亲<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qīn</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>父<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fù</rt></ruby><ruby>母<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǔ</rt></ruby>、<ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>女<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǚ</rt></ruby>、<ruby>弟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>兄<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiōnɡ</rt></ruby>，

<ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>未<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>曾<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>嫁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jià</rt></ruby>、<ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>处<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>女<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǚ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>姐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiě</rt></ruby><ruby>妹<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mèi</rt></ruby>，<ruby>才<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cái</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>沾<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhān</rt></ruby><ruby>染<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>自<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zì</rt></ruby><ruby>己<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jǐ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>祭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jì</rt></ruby><ruby>司<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sī</rt></ruby><ruby>既<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jì</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>民<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mín</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>首<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǒu</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>俗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sú</rt></ruby><ruby>沾<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhān</rt></ruby><ruby>染<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>自<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zì</rt></ruby><ruby>己<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jǐ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Bù</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>使<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>头<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tóu</rt></ruby><ruby>光<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>秃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tū</rt></ruby>；<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>剃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tì</rt></ruby><ruby>除<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chú</rt></ruby><ruby>胡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hú</rt></ruby><ruby>须<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xū</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>周<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōu</rt></ruby><ruby>围<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby>，<ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>用<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>刀<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dāo</rt></ruby><ruby>划<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>身<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēn</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yào</rt></ruby><ruby>归<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuī</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>圣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shènɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>亵<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiè</rt></ruby><ruby>渎<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dú</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>名<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mínɡ</rt></ruby>；<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>火<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>祭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>食<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>物<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wù</rt></ruby>，<ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>献<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>成<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>圣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shènɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Bù</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>娶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>妓<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jì</rt></ruby><ruby>女<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǚ</rt></ruby><ruby>或<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huò</rt></ruby><ruby>被<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèi</rt></ruby><ruby>污<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wū</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>女<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǚ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>妻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qī</rt></ruby>，<ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>娶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>被<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèi</rt></ruby><ruby>休<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiū</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>妇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fù</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>妻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qī</rt></ruby>，<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>祭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jì</rt></ruby><ruby>司<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sī</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>归<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuī</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>圣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shènɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>使<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>成<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>圣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shènɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>奉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>献<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>食<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>物<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wù</rt></ruby>；<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>圣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shènɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>使<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>成<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>圣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>圣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>祭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jì</rt></ruby><ruby>司<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sī</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>女<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǚ</rt></ruby><ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>若<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ruò</rt></ruby><ruby>行<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>淫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yín</rt></ruby><ruby>辱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>没<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mò</rt></ruby><ruby>自<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zì</rt></ruby><ruby>己<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>辱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>没<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mò</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>父<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fù</rt></ruby><ruby>亲<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qīn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>用<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>火<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>将<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>她<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>焚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fén</rt></ruby><ruby>烧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shāo</rt></ruby>。

“<ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zài</rt></ruby><ruby>弟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>兄<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby><ruby>祭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jì</rt></ruby><ruby>司<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sī</rt></ruby>、<ruby>头<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tóu</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>倒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>膏<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡāo</rt></ruby><ruby>油<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yóu</rt></ruby>、<ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>承<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>接<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiē</rt></ruby><ruby>圣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>职<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhí</rt></ruby>、<ruby>穿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chuān</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>圣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>衣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>蓬<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>头<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tóu</rt></ruby><ruby>散<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sàn</rt></ruby><ruby>发<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fà</rt></ruby>，<ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>撕<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sī</rt></ruby><ruby>裂<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liè</rt></ruby><ruby>衣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>服<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fu</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>挨<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">āi</rt></ruby><ruby>近<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìn</rt></ruby><ruby>死<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>尸<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shī</rt></ruby>，<ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>父<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fù</rt></ruby><ruby>母<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>沾<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhān</rt></ruby><ruby>染<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>自<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zì</rt></ruby><ruby>己<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jǐ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>圣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>亵<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiè</rt></ruby><ruby>渎<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dú</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>圣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>膏<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡāo</rt></ruby><ruby>油<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yóu</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>冠<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuān</rt></ruby><ruby>冕<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>头<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tóu</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby>。<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby>。
